Run Cluster-Specific Differential Expression Analysis

run_cluster_de.Rd

Performs differential expression between two sample identities within each specified cell-type cluster using Seurat::FindMarkers. Results are filtered by adjusted p-value and absolute log2 fold-change thresholds, and annotated with a regulation-direction label.

Usage

run_cluster_de(
  obj,
  clusters,
  cluster_col = "final_celltype",
  ident_col = "sample",
  ident1,
  ident2,
  seurat_min_pct = 0.1,
  seurat_logfc_threshold = 0.25,
  padj_thresh = 0.05,
  logfc_thresh = 0.5
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat object containing the RNA assay and metadata columns specified by cluster_col and ident_col.

clusters

Character vector of cluster names (values in the cluster_col metadata column) to iterate over.

cluster_col

Character string naming the metadata column that holds cell-type cluster assignments. Default "final_celltype".

ident_col

Character string naming the metadata column to set as the active identity for the DE comparison (e.g., "sample", "condition"). Default "sample".

ident1

Character string. The first identity level (numerator in the log fold-change calculation). Positive fold-changes indicate genes up-regulated in ident1.

ident2

Character string. The second identity level (denominator).

seurat_min_pct

Numeric. Seurat FindMarkers pre-filter: minimum fraction of cells in either group that must express a gene for it to be tested (passed as FindMarkers(min.pct = )). Like seurat_logfc_threshold, it controls which genes appear in $tested. Set explicitly because the FindMarkers default differs between Seurat 4 (0.1) and Seurat 5 (0.01). Default 0.1, the Seurat 4 default.

seurat_logfc_threshold

Numeric. Seurat FindMarkers pre-filter: minimum absolute log2 fold-change for a gene to be tested at all (passed as FindMarkers(logfc.threshold = )). It controls which genes appear in $tested, and so the universe used by run_go_ora(use_tested_universe = TRUE). Set explicitly because the FindMarkers default differs between Seurat 4 (0.25) and Seurat 5 (0.1). Default 0.25, the Seurat 4 default. This is not the DEG cutoff; use logfc_thresh for that.

padj_thresh

Numeric. Maximum adjusted p-value for a gene to be retained in the filtered output. Default 0.05.

logfc_thresh

Numeric. DEG cutoff: minimum absolute log2 fold-change for a tested gene to be kept in $degs. Default 0.5. Applied after FindMarkers; see seurat_logfc_threshold for the pre-filter that decides which genes are tested.

Value

A named list (one element per cluster). Each element is a list with two data frames:

degs

Genes passing padj_thresh and logfc_thresh. Contains the standard FindMarkers columns plus gene (gene symbol), cluster (the cluster label), comparison ("<ident1>_vs_<ident2>"), and res (direction label: "Upregulated in <ident1>" or "Upregulated in <ident2>").

tested

Unfiltered FindMarkers output: every gene tested in the cluster, with the same gene, cluster, and comparison columns.

If FindMarkers fails for a cluster (for example, too few cells in one identity), a warning is issued and both elements are NULL.

Details

The function subsets the Seurat object to each cluster, sets the active identity to ident_col, and runs Seurat::FindMarkers(assay = "RNA").

If the RNA assay is a Seurat 5 assay (class Assay5), its layers are joined with JoinLayers first, because FindMarkers cannot run on layers split by sample (for example, after merge()). Seurat 3/4 assays are used as they are.
